resources.string: OpenCode Web must already be running on the computer that holds the project. Start it with: opencode web --hostname 0.0.0.0 --port 4096. Set OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD before exposing the server to your local network, and configure an AI model provider on the OpenCode host. Your browser opens the workspace on that server. CodeOnTheGo does not upload project files or store your OpenCode password. Use HTTPS or a trusted VPN for remote access. HTTP is not encrypted; do not expose the server to the public internet.
